verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents API keys as personal access tokens that let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses. It also has a gateway API reference that exposes each workspace as an OpenAI-compatible model, so any OpenAI-style client can drive agent tasks programmatically, and per-user webhooks support long-running work. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found none at the docs-site paths), detailed endpoint-level reference coverage in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
